title: Appliance cost calculations (example price 25p per kWh)
subject: Science
unit: Summer 1: Metals and their uses (8G); energy transfers (8K)
source: Written for science/y8 lesson 56 (Appliance cost calculations sheet with answers (portal worksheet; example price 25p per kWh))
intro: Lesson 56. Energy (kWh) = power (kW) × time (hours). Cost = kWh × price.

questions.q: Which appliance costs the most a day?
questions.a: The fridge (60p), because it is on all day

questions.q: A 60 W bulb is on 8 hours a day for a year. Find the cost at 25p per kWh.
A filament bulb is 10% efficient and an LED is 80% efficient. Why switch?
questions.a: The LED wastes far less energy as heat, so it costs less to run for the same light.
